newsitem.title: USA: Arcadian stake cut by Alpine-led group.
newsitem.headline: Arcadian stake cut by Alpine-led group.

text.p: A group led by Alpine Associates, a Cresskill, N.J., broker-dealer, on Friday said it reduced its stake in Arcadian Corp to 4.995 percent, or 1,935,100 common shares.
In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it sold 120,500 shares of Arcadian on December 4 at prices ranging from $25.875 to $26.00 each.

The group previously held 2,055,600 common shares in the Memphis, Tenn.,-based nitrogen fertilizer and chemical maker. The shares, which were disclosed in another filing Friday, represented a 5.31 percent stake.
The original stake was purchased for $50.55 million, including 669,100 shares bought between October 24 and December 3 at prices ranging from $24.50 to $26.00 a share.
The group said it holds the stake as an investment.
